# 8.css

> A CSS-only Windows 8 Modern UI library with the complete Font Awesome 4.7.0 icon set, bundled and self-hosted.

## Source layout
- `gui/*.css`: maintained CSS modules.
- `vendor/font-awesome/`: unmodified Font Awesome 4.7.0 stylesheet, fonts, and license text.
- `src/8.css`: generated combined stylesheet (Font Awesome + modules).
- `dist/8.css`: complete distribution bundle.
- `dist/gui/*.css`: modular stylesheet distribution.
- `dist/font-awesome/`: self-hosted icon font, stylesheets, and license.
- `styles/images/`: Windows 8 / 8.1 RTM wallpapers and the generated `wallpapers/` pack (manifest, thumbnails, optional classes). Demo assets only, not MIT licensed.
- `examples/wallpapers.html`: Personalize-style wallpaper picker with live Start Screen preview.
- `examples/shell.html`: the assembled Windows 8 shell (lock screen, Start screen, desktop, taskbar) with the edge gestures wired.
- `examples/gestures.js`: demo-only Pointer Events helper for the edge gestures; the library itself stays CSS-only.
- `docs/index.html`: component catalog, previews, and icon gallery.
- `examples/legacy-start-screen.html`: historical Start Screen prototype.
- `AGENTS.md` and `llms-full.txt`: maintainer and agent guidance.

## Principles
- Keep Windows 8 Start Screen and desktop UI recognizable, using flat surfaces and solid color: a horizontally panned Start screen with column-major tiles, no Start button on the RTM taskbar, and edge gestures rather than Windows 10 chrome.
- Use `w8-` class names to reduce collisions, and classic Font Awesome 4.7.0 icon classes (`fa fa-home`).
- Keep runtime CSS-only; icons come from the self-hosted icon font, without JavaScript.
- Use semantic HTML, visible focus, accessible labels, and reduced-motion support.
- Background artwork is opt-in through `--w8-start-image`; never bake an image into the component defaults.
- Do not claim CSS implements application state, keyboard navigation, or window behavior.

## Package
Install with `npm install @flessan/8.css`, then import `@flessan/8.css`. For plain HTML, use `https://unpkg.com/@flessan/8.css@0.2.0/dist/8.css`. The standalone Font Awesome stylesheet is at `https://unpkg.com/@flessan/8.css@0.2.0/dist/font-awesome/css/font-awesome.min.css`.
